notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for standard negotiated willing-to-acquire continuation. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies cancellation of the first candidate, continuation with the next willing-to-acquire candidate, negotiated divestiture confirmation, ownership state, callback tags, and cleanup without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics. The immediate callback-model case remains an explicit candidate skip because immediate If Available delivery reports the unavailable state before a negotiated continuation can exist.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisitionIfAvailable, attributeOwnershipAcquisition, cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, negotiatedAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, and confirmDivestiture with standard ownership callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership-management declarations
